I will do mostly what has worked for me here when the rains are good. On this maize plot I will plant the seed I have seen do well with other farmers, and I will put some fertilizer, but not too much because cash must also cover my other land. I own this plot, so I will also carry manure there, and I will weed with the hand hoe instead of buying spray. I will wait for the rain and not irrigate.
